audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent. Highlander makes him immune to all slowing effects — the page recommends nothing about it while Illaoi's whole hold-him-in-the-field pattern runs on slows. Wuju Style grants true damage, so armour does not answer him. Alpha Strike makes him untargetable, and his own basic attacks pull its cooldown down from 20s.
audit.why: Riot's Highlander text: 'making him immune to all slowing effects'. That is the single reason 2+ item Yi escapes the tentacle field, and it is more specific and more actionable than 'full crit out-scales'. Riot's Alpha Strike text: 'Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown', so the 20s number is a ceiling, not a timer.
audit.corrected: Slow immunity written into the 2+ item why; Alpha Strike's untargetable window written into what Yi wants; Meditate's heal into the new spike and the mid block.
